intention: /supercharger-stats explains in ES+EN that Tesla supplies no battery percentages and that an end-only entry derives the start; and the four dead start/end_battery_pct_est columns are gone from both charging and telemetry. Tiers 4-5 (MAG-45, added 2026-09-03) additionally give a Supercharger session a stored, auto-set three-state status rendered as a ui.Badge, mirroring /charges.
request: Source ticket MAG-36. Part 1 (derive start_battery_pct) already shipped as charging-add-derived-start-battery-pct on 2026-09-01. This roadmap covers the two remaining parts: the bilingual UI help text, and removing the *_pct_est columns the ticket found unpopulated.

decisions.what: This run covers both remaining MAG-36 parts (UI help text + dropping the est columns). Part 1, the start-percentage derivation, is already merged and archived and is not re-implemented.
decisions.why: The ticket was edited after the derivation shipped; only the two later sections are outstanding. The owner confirmed both are in scope.

decisions.what: Drop the four columns directly. No verify-then-drop migration step, no deprecate-in-place option.
decisions.why: Both tables exclude the columns from every write path by design, and integration tests already guard those exclusions. The owner priced the risk and chose the direct drop.

decisions.what: Tier order gateway then charging then telemetry; only tier 2's dependency on tier 1 is real.
decisions.why: The gateway reads charging.Session.StartBatteryPctEst, so charging cannot delete the field first without breaking the build. Telemetry has no consumer outside itself.

decisions.what: One page-level ui.Alert{Kind:"info"} above the sessions table, mirroring dashboard.templ. Not an in-form hint, not a tooltip.
decisions.why: ui.Field has no hint slot, so an in-form hint would change a shared kit component; and an in-form-only message hides the record-your-percentages advice from readers.

decisions.what: The owner's own draft wording, typos and accents corrected, in ES and EN under one new key supercharger.battery_pct_help. Exact strings are in the roadmap D5.
decisions.why: Owner chose the faithful variant over a shorter rewrite, keeping their tone. ES keeps Supercharger as a proper noun, matching the existing catalogue.

decisions.what: analytics/db_integration_test.go is an explicitly granted path on tier 2 rather than a fourth analytics tier.
decisions.why: It is a test seed helper naming both est columns in one INSERT. A whole tier and dispatch to delete two arguments would cost far more than the edit.

decisions.what: No new unit tests. Repair the seven existing test files that stop compiling; delete the telemetry assertions that guard the dropped columns.
decisions.why: Owner's standing default is no new tests. The repairs are required to keep the suite compiling, which is repair rather than new coverage.

decisions.what: Reverse RM27 design D6, which kept the telemetry columns so a future estimator could land without a migration.
decisions.why: The estimator landed as derivedStartBatteryPct and writes the real start_battery_pct column instead, so the reservation is obsolete. Recorded so the drop does not read as an oversight.

decisions.what: Remove the two visible start-estimate/end-estimate table columns, their two i18n keys and both VM label fields. The table goes from 9 columns to 7.
decisions.why: Forced by the column drop, and the owner confirmed the narrower table is wanted rather than repurposing the two slots.

decisions.what: The session status is a STORED column on charging.supercharger_sessions, auto-set on every write. Not computed on read, not user-chosen.
decisions.why: Owner chose it over the cheaper compute-on-read option after seeing that it costs a migration, a design gate and a second module.

decisions.what: Three codes IN_PROGRESS / DONE_CALCULATED / DONE; middle label 'Finalizada (calculada)' / 'Done (calculated)'.
decisions.why: Owner rejected 'Approximate' as misleading. The middle state is a qualified Done, and 'calcular' is already the page's own vocabulary.

decisions.what: MAG-45 ships as tiers 4-5 of RM41 on the same branch, under its own Linear ticket, rather than a separate CH change off main.
decisions.why: It edits the same three Supercharger files tier 1 just rewrote, so a separate branch would conflict on every one of them.

decisions.what: MAG-45 is split into a charging tier (column + write logic) and a gateway tier (badge + copy), tier 5 depending on tier 4.
decisions.why: A stored column belongs to the module owning the table; the gateway may not touch another module's schema. One tier is one module.

decisions.what: internal/charging/db_backfill_integration_test.go is an explicitly granted path on tier 3, not a fourth charging tier.
decisions.why: Its fixture INSERTs into telemetry.supercharger_history naming both est columns, so tier 3's drop breaks it at runtime. Same shape as tier 2's analytics grant.

decisions.what: VerifySession sets the status code itself at write time, using what needsDerivedStartBatteryPct already told it. battery_pct_source is NOT extended with a 'derived' value.
decisions.why: Nothing on the row distinguishes a derived start from a typed one today. The writer is the only place that knows, and a third source value would reverse the rule that the label names a human or measured origin.

decisions.what: The migration backfills ALL 10 existing sessions to DONE_CALCULATED, not the 3 whose stored start matches the recomputed derivation.
decisions.why: Owner confirmed twice against the contrary evidence: Tesla supplies no battery percentages at all, so every historic start was reconstructed, never read from the car. Provenance the owner knows and the data cannot show.

events.what: Roadmap created. MAG-36 part 1 found already merged (PR #39, CH37, archived 2026-09-01); this roadmap covers only the ticket's two later sections. Runtime Claude Code, budget available, no degradations.

Tier 4 started at Step 2. Leader pre-check found a gap the roadmap's D11 never closed: DONE_CALCULATED is defined as 'the start was derived rather than typed', but battery_pct_source has only user_verified/polled and VerifySession writes user_verified for a derived start too, so the stored row cannot tell them apart. Live data confirmed it - all 10 sessions have both percentages and source user_verified. Two owner decisions taken before dispatch (calc marker, backfill).
